Application are invited from the candidates having PG Degree (MD/MS) qualification from any Medical
Teaching lnstitution recognized by the lndian Medical Council (lMC) for the post of SENIOR RESIDENT in
Burdwan Medical College, Purba Bardhhaman in different disciplines as mentioned below. The appointment is
on temporary basis and for one year only. However, the same may be extended for further Two years
depending upon performance of the candidate and upon successful completion of each year's tenure.
Application should be in A4 size Paper and must be submitted by 3'd Day of NOVEMBER,2026 up to 2 P.M. on
all working days except Saturdays, Sunday and Holidays.
Disciplines and No. of posts of SR. Resident-
1. NEURO MEDICINE 01
2. RADTOTOGY 01
Admissible remunerations for the post of Senior Resident as per state Govt. rules at this material time are as
follows-
Rate of remuneration:-
** Rs. 85,000/- (Rupees Eighty Five thousand) only, per month during the 1"t Year, 2nd Year & 3rd Year.
Walk-in-lnterview will be held on 04.09.?026 (WEDNESDAY) at 12 P.M. onwards in the colleee Medical
Education Unit (New Academic Buildins. 1't Floor)No TA DA or other allowance(s) will be paid for attending
lnterview.
General information and instructions for candidates: -
1. No candidate can apply for more than one discipline.
2. No benefit/claim for any qualification/experience shall be admitted unless the same are supported by
autfi enticated documentary evidences.
3. Job responsibilities of Senior resident shall be as follows:
Senior Resident of a Department shall function at hierarchal level above the rank of the Postgraduate
student and below the rank of the basic teachers. He/ She shall function as per directions of the visiting
Staff/faculty Members of the Department and will be responsible for:
PATIENT CARE:
l.Providing bedside patient care including history taking, clinical examination and performing apjropriate
diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.
2.Maintaining case records and bed history tickets.
3.Ensuring investigation and referrals.
4.Emergency duties round the clock, on shift basis.
5.Daily evening rounds.
6.Sunday rounds.
7.Pre-operative and Post-operative care.
